titleStmt.title: Valabhipur Plates of Śīlāditya III, [Valabhī] year 348, Mārgaśira ba. 3

msContents.summary: Grant of land (257 pādāvarta, including two cisterns) in favour of a Sāmavedin.

div.p:
* svasti vijayaskandhāvārāT khoṭāṭavāsakāt prasabhapraṇatāmitrāṇāṁ maitrakāṇām atulabalasaṁpannamaṇḍalābhogasaṁsaktaprahāraśatalabdhapratātāpāt pratāpopanatadāna
mānārjjavopārjjitānurāgād anuraktamaulabhṛtaśreṇībalāvāptarājyaśriyaḥ paramamāheśvaraśrībhaṭārkkād avyavacchinnarājavaṅśāt mātāpitṛcaraṇāravindapraṇatipravidhautāśe
ṣakalmaṣaḥ śaiśavāt prabhṛti khaḍgadvitīyabāhur eva samadaparagajaghaṭāsphoṭanaprakāśitasatvanikaṣas tatprabhāvapraṇatārāticūḍāratnaprabhāsaṁsaktapādanakharaśmisaṁhatiḥ sa
kalasmṛtipraṇītamārggasamyakparipālanaprajāhṛdayarañjanānvarttharājaśabdo rūpakāntisthairyyyagāmbhīryyabuddhisaṁpadbhiḥ smaraśaśāṅkādrirājodadhitridaśagurudhaneśān ati
śayānaḥ śaraṇāgatābhayapradānaparatayā tṛṇavadapāstāśeṣasvakāryyaphalaḥ prārtthanādhikārtthapradānānanditavidvatsuhṛtpraṇayihṛdayaḥ pādacārīva sakalabhu
vanamaṇḍalābhogapramodaḥ paramamāheśvaraḥ śrīguhasenas tasya sutas tatpādanakhamayūkhasantānavisṛtajāhnavījalaughaprakṣālitāśeṣakalmaṣaḥ praṇayiśatasahasro
pajīvyamānaḥsaṁpad rūpalobhād ivāśritaḥ sarabhasam ābhigāmikair guṇais sahajaśaktiśikṣāviśeṣavismāpitākhiladhanurddharaḥ prathamanarapatisamatisṛṣṭānām anupāla
yitā dharmmadāyānām apākarttā prajopaghātakāriṇām upaplavānāṁ darśayitā śrīsarasvatyor ekādhivāsasya saṁhatārātipakṣalakṣmīparibhogadakṣavikramo vikramo
pasaṁprāptavimalapārtthivaśrīḥ paramamāheśvaraḥ śrīdharasenas tasya sutas tatpaādaānuddhyātaḥ sakalajagadānandanātyadbhutaguṇasamudayasthagitasamagra
diṅmaṇḍalaḥ samaraśatavijayaśobhāsanāthamaṇḍalāgradyutibhāsuratarāṁssapīṭhodūḍhagurumanorathamahābhāraḥ sarvvavidyāparāparavibhāgādhigamavimala
matir api sarvvataḥ subhāṣitalavenāpi sukhopapādanīyaparitoṣaḥ samagralokāgādhagāmbhīryyahṛdayo pi sucaritātiśayasuvyaktaparamakalyāṇasvabhā
vaḥ khīilībhūtakṛtayuganṛpatipathaviśodhanādhigatodagrakīrttiḥ dhdharmmānuparodhojjvalatarīkṛtārtthasukhasaṁpadupasevānirūḍhadharmmādityadvitīyanāmā para
mamāheśvaraḥ śrīśīlādityas tasyānujas tatpādānuddhyaātaḥ svayagm upendraguruṇeva guruṇātyādaravatā samabhilaṣaṇīyām api raājalakṣmīṁ skandhāsaktāṁ paramabhadra Iva dhu
ryyas tadājñāsaṁpaādanaikarasatayaivodvahaṁN khedasukharatibhyām anāyāsitasatvasaṁpattiḥ prabhāvasaṁpadvaśīkṛtanṛpatiśataśiroratnacchāyopagūḍhapādapīṭho pi pa
rāvajñābhimānarasānāliṅgitamanovṛttiḥ praṇatim ekāṁ parityajya prakhyātapauruṣābhimānair apy arātibhir anāsāditapratikriyopāyaḥ kṛtanikhilabhuvanāmodavimalaguṇasaṁhatiḥ prasabhavighaṭitasakalakalivilasitagatiḥ nīcajanādhirohibhir aśeṣair ddoṣair anāmṛṣṭātyunnatahṛdayaḥ prakhyā
vimalaguṇasaṁhatiḥ prasabhavighaṭitasakalakalivilasitagatiḥ nīcajanādhirohibhir aśeṣair ddoṣair anāmṛṣṭātyunnatahṛdayaḥ prakhyātapauruṣāstrakauśalā
tiśayagaṇatithavipakṣakṣitipatilakṣmīsvayaṁgrāhaprakāśitapravīrapuruṣaḥprathamasaṁkhyādhigamaḥ paramamāheśvaraḥ śrīkharagrahas tasya tanayas tatpādānuddhyātaḥ
sakalavidyādhigamavihitanikhilavidvajjanamanaḥparitoṣātiśayaḥ satvasaṁpadaā tyāgaudāryyeṇa ca vigatānusandhānāsśamāhitārātipakṣamanorathākṣabhaṅgaḥ
samyagupalakṣitānekaśāstrakalālokacaritagahvaravibhāgo pi paramabhadraprakṛtir akṛtrimapraśrayavinayaśobhāvibhūṣaṇaḥ samaraśatajayapatākāha
raṇapratyalodagrabāhudaṇḍavidhvansitanikhilapratipakṣadarppodayaḥ svadhanuḥprabhāvaparibhūtāstrakauśalābhimānaḥ sakalabhuvananṛpatimaṇḍalābhinanditaśāsanaḥ
paramamaāheśvaraḥ śrīdharasaenas tasyānujas tatpādānuddhyātaḥ saccaritātiśayitasakalapūrvvanarapatir atidussādhānām api prasādhayitā viṣayā
ṇāṁ mūrttimān iva puruṣakāraḥ parivṛddhaguṇānurāganirbbharacittavṛtttibhir mmanur iva svayam abhyupapannaḥ prakṛtibhir adhigatakalākalāpaẖ kāntimān timā ni
rvriṛtihetur akalaṅkaẖ kumudanāthaḥ prājyaprāatāpasthagitadigantarālapradhṛvansitadhvāntarāśiḥ satatoditaḥ savitāḥ prakṛtibhyaḥ paraṁ pratyayam artthavantam atibahutidha
thaprayojanānubandham āgamaparipūrṇṇaṁ vidadhānaḥ sandhivigrahasamāsaniścayanipuṇaḥ sthāne nurūpam ādeśanṁn dadad guṇavṛddhividhānajanita
saṁskaāraḥ sādhūnāṁ rājyaśālāturīyantantrayor ubhayor api niṣṇātaḥ prakṛṣṭavikramo pi karuṇāmṛduhṛdayaḥ śrutavān apy agarvvitaẖ kānto pi praśamī
sthirasauhṛdayyo pi nirasitā doṣavatām udayasamayasamupajanitajanatānurāgaparipihitabhuvanasamartthitaprāathitabālādityadvitīyanā
mā paramamāheśvaraḥ śrīdhruvasenas tasya sutas tatpādakamalapraṇāmadharaṇikaṣaṇajanitakiṇalāñchanalalāṭacandraśakalaḥ śiśubhaāva Eva śra
vaṇanihitamauktikālaṅkāravibhramāmalaśrutaviśaeṣaḥ pradānasalilakṣālitāgrahāastaāravindaẖ kanyāyaā Iva mṛdukaragrahaṇād ama
mandīkṛtānandavidhir vvasundharāyāẖ kārmuke dhanurveda Iva saṁbhāvitāśeṣalakṣyakalāpaḥ praṇatasāmantamaṇḍalottamāṅgadhṛtacūḍāratnāyamāna
śāsanaḥ paramamāheśvaraḥ paramabhaṭṭārakamahārājādhirājaparameśvaracakravarttiśrīdharasenas tatpitāmahabhrātṛśrīśīlādityasya sśśā
rṅgapāṇer ivāṅgajanmano bhaktibandhurāvayavayavakalpitapraṇater atidhavalayā dūraṁ tatpādāravindapravṛttayā nakhamaṇirucā mandākinye
va nityam amalitottamāṅgadeśasyaāgastyasyaaiva rājarṣer ddākṣiṇyam aātanvānasya prabaladhavalimnā yaśasāṁ valayena maṇḍitakakubhā nabhasi yāminīpater vviḍambi
tākhaṇḍapariveṣamaṇḍalasya payodaśyāmatamaśikharacuūcukaruciirasahyavindhyastanayugāyāḥ kṣiteḥ patyuḥ śrīḍerabhaṭasyāṅgajaḥ kṣitipasaṁhater anurāgiṇyaāḥ
śuciyaśoṅśukabhṛtaḥ svayaṁvaramālām iva rājyaśriyam arppayantyaāẖ kṛtaparigrahaḥ śoauryyam apratihatavyāpāram ānamitapracaṇḍaripumaṇḍalaṁ maṇḍalāgram ivāvalambamānaḥ
śaradi prasabham ākṛṣṭaśilīmukhabāṇāsanāpāditaprasādhanaānāṁ parabhuvāṁ vidhivad ācaritakaragrahaṇaḥ pūrvvam eva vividhavarṇṇojjvalena śrutātiśayenodbhāsita
śravaṇaḥ punaḫ punar ukteneva ratnālaṅkāreṇālaṅkṛtaśrotraḥ parisphurakttkaṭakavikaṭakīṭapakṣaratnakiraṇam avicchinnapradānasalilanivahāvasekavilasannavaśaiva
lāṅkuram ivāgrapāṇim udvahaN dhṛtaviśālaratnavalayajaladhivielātaṭāyamānabhujapariṣvaktaviśvaṁbharaḥ paramamāheśvaraḥ śrīdhruvasenas tasyāgrajo paramahīpatisypa
rśadoṣanāśanadhiyeva lakṣmyā svayad im atisypaṣṭaceṣṭam āśliṣṭāṅgayaṣṭir atirucirataracaritagarimaparikalitasakalanarapatir atiprakṛṣṭānurāgarasarabhasavaśīkṛtapra
ṇatasamastasāmantacakracūḍāmaṇimayūkhakhacitacaraṇarkamalayugalaḥ proddāmodāradorddaṇḍadalitadviṣadvarggadarppaḥ prasarppatpaṭīyaḫpratāpaploṣitaāśaeṣaśatru
vaṅśaḥ praṇayipakṣanikṣiptalakṣmīkaḥ preitagapadotkṣiptasudarśanacakraḥ parihṛtabālakrīḍo nadhaẖkṛtadvijātir ekavikramaprasādhitadharitrītalo naṅgīkṛtajalaśa
yyo pūrvvapuruṣottamaḥ sākṣād dharmma Iva samyagvyavasthāpiktavarṇṇāśramaācāraḥ pūrvvair apy ūrvvīpatibhis tṛṣṇālavalubdhair yyāny apahṛtāni devabrahmadeyāni tepṣā

puūrvvataḥ dāsakasatkakṣetraṁ . dakṣiṇataḥ devakulapāṭakagrāmasīmā Aparataḥ devakulapāṭakagrāmasīmeva Uttarataḥ brāhmaṇasoṭṭakasatkakṣetraṁ
tathā Aparasīmny eva tretarikā paṁcaviṅśatibhūpādāvarttaparisarā vāpī yasyaāḥ pūrvvataḥ brāhmaṇagopadinnasatkakṣetraṁ dakṣiṇataḥ bahu-Ārāṇaka
grāmasīmā Aparataḥ brāhmaṇasarasvatīsatkakṣetraṁ Uttarataḥ brāhmaṇabābhasatkakṣetraṁ tathā hastavaprāhāre sādhisāvasadhigrāme Aparasīmni daṭabhā-
